description: Living soundscapes, read by AmbientSoundscape. A place plays one unpitched bed plus scheduled one-shots; every interval, level, pan and pitch is rolled, so it never plays back identically. vol_db is relative to the bed level (music slider + SoundManager.AMBIENT_OFFSET_DB). Phases are day and night; dawn reads day and dusk reads night unless a place names the band itself. PILOT 2026-10-31: built only from sounds already in the bank. `gaps` names what the place still needs and is not yet generated.

gaps: base_day: >=60s unpitched bed, open-air wind under a distant crowd murmur (bank beds are 5s and loop audibly)
base_night: >=60s crickets and light wind (bank bed is 12s)
cart_wheels: wooden cart rolling past on cobbles, 3 variants
laugh_distant: a short laugh across a square, 3 variants
chapel_bell_distant: one distant bell toll, 2 variants
dog_bark_distant: one or two barks, far off
night: lone_dog (single far bark), owl (one call)
base_day: >=60s unpitched canopy bed, leaves and wind (bank bed is 5s with birdsong baked in, so the birds loop)
base_night: >=60s crickets and wind (bank bed is 12s)
birdsong one-shots: 3 species, short phrases, so birds stop looping with the bed
woodpecker: one short run of knocks
creek_trickle: a few seconds of water over stones
